Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking mass spectrometry (CXMS) study using the BS3 crosslinker. While the acquisition is DDA-like (precursor and fragment scans), it is specifically targeted at identifying cross-linked peptides. Base workflow is set to dda_lfq as no isotopic labeling was used.

scope: analyzed via LC-MS/MS KRAS (human, residues 1-169) bound to intact BRAF (human) in an autoinhibited state with MEK1 (human, ) and a 14-3-3 (SF9) dimer
The complex of BRAF, MEK1, and insect cell derived 14-3-3 ε, ζ co-purified through Ni-NTA- and Strep- affinity chromatography and finally through size-exclusion chromatography
Complexes cross-linked with BS3 were denatured in 8 M urea and subjected to reduction and carbamidomethylation with TCEP and iodoacetamide. Samples were diluted to 2 M urea and digested with trypsin
